sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS lines,CHECKSUM_AGG(BINARY_CHECKSUM(po.PurchaseOrderID,po.SupplierID,po.OrderDate,po.LastEditedWhen,pol.PurchaseOrderLineID,pol.StockItemID,pol.OrderedOuters,pol.ReceivedOuters,pol.LastEditedWhen)) AS checksum FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrders po JOIN Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines pol ON po.PurchaseOrderID=pol.PurchaseOrderID WHERE po.OrderDate < ?

SELECT po.PurchaseOrderID,po.SupplierID,po.OrderDate,po.ExpectedDeliveryDate,po.LastEditedWhen,po.IsOrderFinalized FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrders po WHERE po.OrderDate < ? ORDER BY po.OrderDate,po.PurchaseOrderID

SELECT pol.PurchaseOrderLineID,pol.PurchaseOrderID,pol.StockItemID,pol.OrderedOuters,pol.ReceivedOuters,pol.PackageTypeID,pol.LastReceiptDate,pol.IsOrderLineFinalized,pol.LastEditedWhen,si.QuantityPerOuter FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines pol JOIN Purchasing.PurchaseOrders po ON po.PurchaseOrderID=pol.PurchaseOrderID JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID=pol.StockItemID WHERE po.OrderDate < ? ORDER BY pol.PurchaseOrderLineID

SELECT si.StockItemID,si.QuantityPerOuter,si.ValidFrom,si.ValidTo FROM Warehouse.StockItems FOR SYSTEM_TIME ALL si WHERE si.ValidFrom < ? AND si.StockItemID IN (SELECT pol.StockItemID FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines pol JOIN Purchasing.PurchaseOrders po ON po.PurchaseOrderID=pol.PurchaseOrderID WHERE po.OrderDate<'20160101') ORDER BY si.StockItemID,si.ValidFrom

SELECT s.SupplierID,s.ValidFrom,s.ValidTo FROM Purchasing.Suppliers FOR SYSTEM_TIME ALL s WHERE s.ValidFrom < ? AND s.SupplierID IN (SELECT po.SupplierID FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrders po WHERE po.OrderDate<'20160101') ORDER BY s.SupplierID,s.ValidFrom

SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS lines,CHECKSUM_AGG(BINARY_CHECKSUM(po.PurchaseOrderID,po.SupplierID,po.OrderDate,po.LastEditedWhen,pol.PurchaseOrderLineID,pol.StockItemID,pol.OrderedOuters,pol.ReceivedOuters,pol.LastEditedWhen)) AS checksum FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrders po JOIN Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines pol ON po.PurchaseOrderID=pol.PurchaseOrderID WHERE po.OrderDate < ?
